The unit step function $u(t)$ is defined as

$$
u(t)={\begin{aligned}1,\,t\ge 0, \\ 0,\,t<0.\end{aligned}
$$

Evaluating $f(t)$ at $t=1,$ we have

$$
\begin{aligned}f(1) & =7u(1-1) \\  & =7u(0) \\  & =7\cdot 1 \\  & =7.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(1)=7.$
